body: The matching `#endif` needs to be removed as well.
This should be moved below the logic to store the command line flags.
I removed the `#endif` in my commit. They'll get squashed together in the end

I vaguely recall talking about this previously, but how did we end up with `List<String>` for the arguments? That's not the best data type for this, and this is a new API so we _shouldn't_ be stuck with it for legacy reasons

This NDK version is out-dated now, I think we need:

```suggestion
	android_deps.push_back("ndk;28.1.13356709");
```

In the "finished version", it would be kind of nice to segregate these variables somehow. At minimum, putting them in a `struct` just to group them under a common name, or at maximum we could make a class that has all the callback functions on it as well
Hm, this has the various versions as well. Is one of the two places unused?
